texts.text: A licensed Brain Gym Instructor/Consultant, Reiki Master and Kinesiologist / Touch for Health Teacher, and a little more :)

ops.insert: A licensed Brain Gym Instructor/Consultant, Reiki Master and Kinesiologist / Touch for Health Teacher, and a little more :)

texts.text:
José Toussaint is a Brisbane-based kinesiologist, educator, and facilitator with over two decades of experience in holistic health and movement-based learning.

She specialises in Touch for Health, Brain Gym (Educational Kinesiology), Neuroenergetic Kinesiology, and Primitive Reflex integration, supporting people to reconnect with their body’s innate intelligence and restore balance across physical, emotional, and mental wellbeing.

Originally from the Netherlands, José lived in New Zealand for ten years before settling in Australia in 2005. 
Her journey began in 2001 with Reiki and Neurolink. 
When she came to downunder she continued learning, practising and has been teaching since 2014. 
Her work is grounded, practical, and deeply human, shaped by years of working with individuals, families, students, and practitioners from all walks of life.

José is a Touch for Health instructor (Levels 1–4) and offers workshops, practitioner training, and client sessions both face-to-face in Brisbane and online. 

She is passionate about making complex concepts accessible, using movement, metaphor, and real-life examples to create meaningful learning experiences.

José is known for her warmth, integrity, and showing up. It is important to her that she creates a safe and welcoming space where people feel seen, supported, and empowered to make lasting change.

“Feel the difference with kinesiology.”
